caveats.summary: A fund's constraint tier is our reading of the Description of Funds narrative, not a figure the city printed.
caveats.text: A fund's constraint tier is OUR reading of the Description of Funds narrative (Budget Book pp. 258-261), not something the city printed. Each fund node carries the note it was read from. "unknown" means the document does not establish a restriction; it is a classification, not a gap.

caveats.summary: This document holds the same money at two grains, so summing every link double-counts.
caveats.text: This document holds the same money at more than one grain, so summing every link double-counts: 44 fact(s) are behind both a department's object rows and the fund-to-department link that totals them. Fold within one tier pair, never across the whole graph. It publishes no headline for this reason.

caveats.summary: Only the General Fund has a spending side; the other 5 groups' revenue ends at their funds.
caveats.text: Only the General Fund has a spending side. Budget Book pp.167-170 decompose that fund alone, so the other 5 fund groups' revenue ends at their funds -- the money is not missing, the schedule that would break it down is not published.
